summary:
It was (a) wonderful (b) nice (c) medium (d) dull (e) awful (f) none of the above to hear from you. I have of course reported you to the police for having an affair with a 13 year old girl, but I do not want this to interfere with our friend­ ship, inasmuch as I did it out of civic duty. On the other hand, it occurs to me that perhaps you are having the affair out of civic duty, so perhaps I made a mis­ take. I shall at my earliest convenience ask the police if this be so. 
We are not coming to Canada because Tessa (my wife) just recently gave birth to a two-headed calf, which I interpret to mean that rather than going to Canada we should stay here and sell tickets (all kidding aside, we now have a month-old baby boy named Christopher). So we are nailed tight here in gunjy Fullerton forever, all our dreams shattered and our money spent on doctor and hospital bills (I kid you not). 

I wrote and sold two (2) new novels to Doubleday, the first coming out next Spring, the other coming our probably the year after that. The first one is called FLOW MY TEARS, THE POLICEMAN SAID, and you vill [sic] like it. The other is called A SCANNER DARKLY and is based on my experiences at X- Kalay. Nobody knew it at the time (including me) but my entire time in the dope subculture was actually for the purpose of gathering material for this novel.
